rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Sunday Oct 18 — US equities closed, spot crypto only. BTC 82,085.54 (+0.3% vs 81,867 midnight open, +0.66% vs Saturday entry); ETH 2,420 (-0.1%), SOL 104.05 (-0.3%), XRP 1.298, DOGE 0.0794 — flat tape, no fresh crypto catalyst.
positions.driver: Low-edge weekend: stay in the deepest-liquidity, lowest-vol spot asset and the relative leader into Monday's equity open. Alts still carry October ETF outflows. Unleveraged spot; standard 10% spot stop. Monday run can rotate into equities/leveraged ETFs if a real catalyst appears.
positions.risks: Sunday-night thin-liquidity flush / CME gap dynamics into Monday; macro risk-off from hot inflation prints and continued fund outflows; Robinhood market-maker spread ~1.9% (bid 81,323 / ask 82,876) so real round-trip friction exceeds the paper mark. Stop 73,876.99 (-10%).
